messages:
maria_support: Hey - customer @JaneCorp (customer_jane) reporting intermittent 429s on project 'jane-portal' yesterday afternoon. Project quota tile shows ~75% available but customer hit a hard rate limit. They also say invoice has unexpectedly high token usage. Can someone triage?

aj_sre: Can you paste org_id + project_id and an example trace_id?

maria_support: org_id=org_589, project_id=proj_jane_01, trace_id=trace_0xabc123. Errors seen ~2025-06-15T14:22-14:45Z. API error: 429 {"code":"rate_limit_exceeded", "message":"project quota exceeded"}. Customer attached curl and response.

kevin_billing: grabbing ledger rows for org_589/project proj_jane_01 now. Preliminary: ledger shows ~275k tokens billed in that 20m window, but realtime meter shows ~140k. Suspicious: two ingestion pipelines (api-gateway & edge-proxy) reported events with slightly different request_ids. Possible double-count.

tina_pm: FYI we migrated org-pooling config last week to unify burst settings across orgs. Could that have caused "billing key" to flip from project -> org in some code path? @aj_sre

aj_sre: Looking at routing logs: most requests routed to dedicated pool for proj_jane_01. But I see ~280 meter events where billing_key was set to org_589 instead of proj_jane_01. Those events line up with the 14:22-14:30 spike.

maria_support: customer says they were on a short-lived replay from their client during retries. They share this snippet they used to reproduce: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \\
  -H 'X-Org-Id: org_589' \\
  -H 'X-Project-Id: proj_jane_01' \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","prompt":"Hello"}'
```

aj_sre: aha — repro clue. There's a proxy shim (old edge-proxy) that for a brief code path set billing_key=org_id even when X-Project-Id present because of header precedence bug introduced in commit abcdef. If the proxy replayed a request it also rewrote request_id, so the billing pipeline saw two distinct events for what was logically one request. That explains double-count + 429s while UI tile still showed available (UI reads project-meter, billing ledger had org-attributed duplicates).

kevin_billing: Confirmed: ledger rows show pairs of events ~200ms apart with same trace_id but different request_id and one attributed to org. Dedup currently keys only on request_id. We'll add a dedupe pass that uses trace_id (if present) within a 5m sliding window. Also preparing an invoice adjustment for JaneCorp for the duplicated tokens.

aj_sre: I'll open a hotfix PR to the proxy shim to ensure X-Project-Id wins and to preserve original request_id on retries. Will canary roll in ~10m.

quota-bot: deploy queued by aj_sre -> canary -> prod (10m) :rocket:

kevin_billing: I've created billing ticket BILL-4521 to apply a credit for the duplicated ~135k tokens and to notify customer.

maria_support: Thanks all. I told customer we're issuing a credit and deploying a fix; they'll wait for final confirmation. ETA to update them: 2h. :pray:

aj_sre: Hotfix merged to canary and flipped. Monitoring shows no further duplicate meter events for that project in the next 45m. Closing this thread but will add to postmortem and migration checklist.

maria_support: marking as resolved from support side. Will follow up with postmortem link once available. :white_check_mark:
